007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonInclude;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.PropertyNamingStrategies;
012
013import java.util.ArrayList;
014import java.util.Collections;
015import java.util.List;
016
017/**
018 * Attributes used to create or update a Select AI Agent.
019 *
020 * <p>The database requires {@code profile_name} and {@code role} when the
021 * agent is created. The builder permits these values to be unset or blank;
022 * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT} validates the required creation values and the
023 * supplied attribute names and values when an update is attempted.
024 * The builder checks the documented {@code shortTermMemoryLength} range in
025 * Java.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>To create a supervisor-led team, designate its supervisor with
028 * {@link Builder#supervisor(Boolean) supervisor(true)} at agent creation and
029 * reference that agent with {@link TeamAttributes.Builder#supervisorAgent(String)}.
030 * The supervisor flag cannot be changed after creation. Worker agents remain
031 * separate from the supervisor in the team's agent-task mappings.</p>
032 *
033 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateAgentSample.html">
034 *      CreateAgentSample source</a>
035 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetAgentAttributesSample.html">
036 *      SetAgentAttributesSample source</a>
037 * @since 1.1.0
038 */
039public final class AgentAttributes {
040    /** Configured once and never mutated; shared across attribute serializations. */
041    private static final ObjectMapper MAPPER = new ObjectMapper()
042            .setPropertyNamingStrategy(PropertyNamingStrategies.SNAKE_CASE)
043            .setDefaultPropertyInclusion(JsonInclude.Include.NON_NULL);
044
045    /** AI profile used by the agent to call the model. */
046    private final String profileName;
047    /** Agent role sent to the model. */
048    private final String role;
049    /** Whether the agent can request human input. */
050    private final Boolean enableHumanTool;
051    /** Tool names available to the agent. */
052    private final List<String> tools;
053    /** Maximum number of conversation turns included in model calls. */
054    private final Integer shortTermMemoryLength;
055    /** Whether this agent acts as a supervisor. */
056    private final Boolean supervisor;
057
058    private AgentAttributes(Builder builder) {
059        this.profileName = builder.profileName;
060        this.role = builder.role;
061        this.enableHumanTool = builder.enableHumanTool;
062        this.tools = builder.tools == null ? null : List.copyOf(builder.tools);
063        this.shortTermMemoryLength = builder.shortTermMemoryLength;
064        this.supervisor = builder.supervisor;
065    }
066
067    /**
068     * Returns the AI profile name.
069     *
070     * @return AI profile name, or {@code null} when unset
071     */
072    public String getProfileName() {
073        return profileName;
074    }
075
076    /**
077     * Returns the agent role.
078     *
079     * @return agent role, or {@code null} when unset
080     */
081    public String getRole() {
082        return role;
083    }
084
085    /**
086     * Returns whether the human tool is enabled.
087     *
088     * @return whether the human tool is enabled, or {@code null} when unset
089     */
090    public Boolean getEnableHumanTool() {
091        return enableHumanTool;
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * Returns configured tool names.
096     *
097     * @return immutable tool names, or {@code null} when unset
098     */
099    public List<String> getTools() {
100        return tools == null ? null : Collections.unmodifiableList(tools);
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * Returns the short-term memory length.
105     *
106     * @return short-term memory length, or {@code null} when unset
107     */
108    public Integer getShortTermMemoryLength() {
109        return shortTermMemoryLength;
110    }
111
112    /**
113     * Returns whether the agent is a supervisor.
114     *
115     * @return whether the agent is a supervisor, or {@code null} when unset
116     */
117    public Boolean getSupervisor() {
118        return supervisor;
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * Creates a builder for agent attributes.
123     *
124     * @return mutable builder for agent attributes
125     */
126    public static Builder builder() {
127        return new Builder();
128    }
129
130    /**
131     * Serializes attributes using the snake-case names expected by
132     * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT}.
133     *
134     * @return JSON object containing non-null attributes
135     * @throws IllegalStateException when the attributes cannot be serialized
136     */
137    public String toJson() {
138        try {
139            return MAPPER.writeValueAsString(this);
140        } catch (Exception e) {
141            throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to serialize AgentAttributes", e);
142        }
143    }
144
145    /** Builder for {@link AgentAttributes}. */
146    public static final class Builder {
147        /** AI profile used by the agent. */
148        private String profileName;
149        /** Agent role sent to the model. */
150        private String role;
151        /** Whether human-tool use is enabled. */
152        private Boolean enableHumanTool;
153        /** Tool names available to the agent. */
154        private List<String> tools;
155        /** Maximum short-term memory length. */
156        private Integer shortTermMemoryLength;
157        /** Whether the agent is a supervisor. */
158        private Boolean supervisor;
159
160        /**
161         * Sets the AI profile name.
162         *
163         * @param profileName AI profile name
164         * @return this builder
165         */
166        public Builder profileName(String profileName) {
167            this.profileName = profileName;
168            return this;
169        }
170
171        /**
172         * Sets the agent role.
173         *
174         * @param role role assigned to the agent
175         * @return this builder
176         */
177        public Builder role(String role) {
178            this.role = role;
179            return this;
180        }
181
182        /**
183         * Sets whether the agent can request human input.
184         *
185         * @param enableHumanTool whether human-tool requests are enabled
186         * @return this builder
187         */
188        public Builder enableHumanTool(Boolean enableHumanTool) {
189            this.enableHumanTool = enableHumanTool;
190            return this;
191        }
192
193        /**
194         * Sets the names of tools available to the agent.
195         *
196         * @param tools tool names; the list is copied by the builder
197         * @return this builder
198         */
199        public Builder tools(List<String> tools) {
200            this.tools = tools == null ? null : new ArrayList<>(tools);
201            return this;
202        }
203
204        /**
205         * Sets the short-term memory length.
206         *
207         * @param shortTermMemoryLength non-negative memory length, or
208         *        {@code null} to use the database default
209         * @return this builder
210         * @throws IllegalArgumentException when the value is negative
211         */
212        public Builder shortTermMemoryLength(Integer shortTermMemoryLength) {
213            if (shortTermMemoryLength != null && shortTermMemoryLength < 0) {
214                throw new IllegalArgumentException("shortTermMemoryLength must be non-negative");
215            }
216            this.shortTermMemoryLength = shortTermMemoryLength;
217            return this;
218        }
219
220        /**
221         * Sets whether the agent is a supervisor at creation time. The database
222         * does not allow changing this flag after creation. Assign the created
223         * supervisor to a team using
224         * {@link TeamAttributes.Builder#supervisorAgent(String)}; do not include
225         * it in that team's worker agent-task mappings.
226         *
227         * <p>For a runnable example, see
228         * <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SupervisorTeamSample.html">
229         * SupervisorTeamSample source</a>.</p>
230         *
231         * @param supervisor whether the agent supervises other agents
232         * @return this builder
233         */
234        public Builder supervisor(Boolean supervisor) {
235            this.supervisor = supervisor;
236            return this;
237        }
238
239        /**
240         * Builds agent attributes without validating required database fields.
241         * Required-field and semantic validation is performed by
242         * {@code DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT} when the agent is created.
243         *
244         * @return immutable agent attributes
245         */
246        public AgentAttributes build() {
247            return new AgentAttributes(this);
248        }
249    }
250}
